meta.name: google-agents-cli-adk-code
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "write agent code", "build an agent with ADK", "add a tool", "create a callback", "define an agent", "use state management" — in a project that needs ADK (Agent Development Kit) API patterns and code examples. It provides a quick reference for agent types, tool definitions, orchestration patterns, callbacks, state management, the graph Workflow API, and reference recipes to study. Do NOT use for scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold) or deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为智能体补上工具、回调与状态管理,把设计落成可运行的代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在用 ADK 搭建智能体,需要照着范例写工具、回调与状态管理。
copy.tagline_en: Write runnable ADK agents with tools, callbacks, and state handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an ADK agent and need patterns for tools, callbacks, and state.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会参照 ADK(Agent Development Kit)的 API 模式和代码示例来写 agent 代码:定义 agent、加工具与回调、状态管理、多 agent 编排、图 Workflow API,也能按能力查对应的参考配方。写代码前会先确认项目已搭好脚手架。
howto.when: 当你要写 agent 代码、用 ADK 构建 agent、加工具或写回调等时触发。搭脚手架请用 scaffold 技能,部署请用 deploy 技能,这两个它不接管。
